description: A SessionStart(compact) hook that nudges a compacted lead to run lead-revive before anything else, and the Claude mod (claude-mod/register.ts), the one hooks module Claude Code accepts per plugin. Its mailbox push feature: arriving cross-session mail for the bound session key starts a turn even in an idle session, and mail arriving while a main-thread turn runs joins that turn at its next tool call's result; where the workflow manual injection feature owns the conversation's key (ws, in a ws project) the mod binds every key the conversation gets itself and registers no bind tool, and elsewhere the agent binds its key through the mod's mailbox watch tool. Its lead compaction timing feature (ws only): advisory and milestone wake turns before native auto compaction, and a compaction request tool the lead calls at a boundary of its choosing, whose continuation a prompt typed during the compaction carries. Its MCP reconnect feature: a reconnect request tool the agent calls when the plugin's MCP server has gone, and a /mcp reconnect at the next main-thread turn end followed by the agent's continuation. Its workflow manual injection feature (ws only, in a project with ai-docs/WORKFLOW.md at its repository root): a lead session key minted per conversation and the keyed workflow manual carried in the system prompt, workflow_manual answered with the session state alone while the prompt carries the manual, a repeated playbook_read or workflow_manual collapsed to a pointer while its earlier result is still in the conversation, and a main-thread workflow_manual call with another lead key (a revive) adopted as the conversation's key. Claude Code auto-discovers this file by its hooks/hooks.json path; there is no plugin.json pointer to it (contrast the Codex adapter, whose manifest names its hooks file explicitly).
